app.name: Scan-to-Drive
app.tagline: Company car trips, logged with a scan.

home.title: Every company trip, logged with one scan
home.lead: Drivers scan the car, passengers confirm with their ID, and the transport office sees every trip live.
home.driverHint: Sign in with your employee ID and PIN
home.passengerNote: Passenger? Scan the QR code the driver shows you. No sign-in needed.

placeholder.title: This screen is being built
placeholder.body: It arrives in step {step} of the frontend build.

overtime.title: Driver overtime
overtime.lead: Overtime will be worked out from the trips drivers already log, so nobody has to fill in a separate sheet.
overtime.point1Body: Each driver's trip times compared with their working hours, day by day.
overtime.point2Body: Totals for the month, with the trips behind every hour.
overtime.point3Body: Approve overtime and export it to Excel for HR and accounts.
overtime.note: Tell us your shift rules (start time, end time, weekends, holidays) and we will plan this with you.

dashboard.overtimeHint: Hours beyond the shift and monthly totals, in the next phase.

cards.waiting: Waiting for a passenger to confirm

board.title: Cars right now
board.hint: {count, plural, one {# car} other {# cars}}, live

live.title: Trips running now
live.hint: {count, plural, one {# open trip} other {# open trips}}
live.emptyBody: When a driver starts a trip it shows up here within a few seconds.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.emptyBody: No open alerts. The checks run every minute.
alerts.notePlaceholder: e.g. Called the driver, odometer photo checked

charts.noKm: No finished trips this month yet.
charts.tripsHint: {count, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}} so far

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.lead: Every shared piece of the interface in one place. Only shown while developing.

driverAuth.signInLead: Use your employee ID and 4-digit PIN. This phone keeps you signed in for 30 days.
driverAuth.firstTimeHint: First time? Type any 4 digits. You will choose your own PIN on the next screen.
driverAuth.choosePinLead: Pick 4 digits you will remember. Easy ones like 1111 or 1234 are not allowed.
driverAuth.confirmPinLead: Just to be sure it is right.
driverAuth.forgotPin: Forgot your PIN? Ask the transport office to reset it.
driverAuth.errWrong: Employee ID or PIN is not correct.
driverAuth.errLocked: Too many wrong tries. Wait 15 minutes or ask the transport office.
driverAuth.errWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
driverAuth.errMismatch: The two PINs are different. Try again.
driverAuth.errAlreadySet: Your PIN is already set. Sign in with it, or ask the transport office to reset it.
driverAuth.errNetwork: No connection. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
driverAuth.errServer: Something went wrong. Please try again.

driverHome.scanBody: Scan the QR sticker in the car. The car page opens by itself.
driverHome.typeCode: No sticker? Type the car code
driverHome.offlineBody: Check that the backend is running, then reload this page.
driverHome.noticeCancelled: The trip was cancelled. The car is free again.

carPage.notFoundBody: Check the car code. If the sticker is wrong, tell the transport office.
carPage.outdatedBody: This car got a new QR sticker. Scan the new one, or type the car code.
carPage.offlineBody: Check the Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
carPage.genericBody: Please try again in a moment.
carPage.otherTripTitle: You already have an open trip
carPage.otherTripBody: Trip {trip} on {car} is still open. Finish it before starting another one.
carPage.maintenanceBody: It cannot be used for trips right now. Ask the transport office.
carPage.inactiveTitle: This car is not in use
carPage.inactiveBody: It has been taken out of service. Ask the transport office.

scanner.title: Scan the car's QR sticker
scanner.notOurs: That is not a Scan-to-Drive car sticker. Point at the sticker inside the car.
scanner.hint: Hold the phone so the sticker fits in the frame. It reads by itself.
scanner.deniedBody: Allow the camera for this site: tap the lock or (i) next to the address, turn on Camera, then try again.
scanner.nocameraBody: This phone did not give a camera. Type the car code instead.
scanner.insecureTitle: The camera needs a secure address
scanner.insecureBody: Open the app with an address that starts with https://. Until then, type the car code.
scanner.failedBody: Close other apps that use the camera and try again, or type the car code.

tripForm.gps_denied: Location is blocked. The trip still works.
tripForm.gps_unavailable: Location not found. The trip still works.
tripForm.fixHighlighted: Please fill in the marked fields.
tripForm.kmTooLow: Lower than the last end km ({km}). Check the meter.
tripForm.kmRequired: Type the km shown on the meter.
tripForm.kmHint: The last trip ended at {km} km.
tripForm.kmGapWarn: That is {gap} km more than where the last trip ended. Check the meter; the office will see this gap.
tripForm.withPassengerHint: The passenger confirms the start by scanning a QR on your phone.
tripForm.noPassengerHint: For errands like fuel or servicing. A purpose is needed.
tripForm.purposeRequired: Say what the trip is for.
tripForm.photoHint: The km on the meter must be readable
tripForm.endKmTooLow: Must be more than the start km ({km}).

tripErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
tripErrors.network: No connection. Check the Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
tripErrors.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
tripErrors.START_KM_TOO_LOW: The start km is lower than the last end km ({km}). Check the meter.
tripErrors.END_KM_TOO_LOW: The end km must be more than the start km ({km}).
tripErrors.PURPOSE_REQUIRED: A purpose is needed for a trip without a passenger.
tripErrors.PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large. Take it again.
tripErrors.INVALID_PHOTO: That file is not a photo. Take the photo with the camera.
tripErrors.PHOTO_SAVE_FAILED: The photo could not be saved. Please try again.
tripErrors.STICKER_OUTDATED: This car has a new sticker. Scan the new one.
tripErrors.CAR_IN_USE: Someone else just started a trip on this car.
tripErrors.CAR_INACTIVE: This car is not in use.
tripErrors.DRIVER_HAS_OPEN_TRIP: You already have an open trip.
tripErrors.OPEN_TRIP_EXISTS: This car or you already have an open trip.
tripErrors.TRIP_LOCKED: Too many wrong IDs were typed. Ask the transport office.
tripErrors.TRIP_NOT_IN_PROGRESS: This trip is not running any more.
tripErrors.CANT_SCAN_NOT_ALLOWED: This option is switched off. Ask the transport office.
tripErrors.CSRF_CHECK_FAILED: Reload the page and try again.

qrView.endTitle: Ask the passenger to confirm the end
qrView.startBody: They scan it with their phone camera and type their employee ID.
qrView.endBody: They scan it and type the same employee ID as at the start.
qrView.endBodyVisitor: They scan it and type the same phone number as at the start.
qrView.blocked: Blocked after too many wrong IDs. Ask the transport office to unlock it, or cancel.
qrView.noCode: The code is not on this phone any more.
qrView.reminder: Still waiting. Make a new QR, tap "Passenger can't scan", or cancel.
qrView.cancelBody: Only before the passenger confirms. The car is free again straight away.
qrView.cantScanBody: The trip goes on without the passenger's confirmation and the transport office approves it later.

reasons.cancel2: The trip is not needed any more
reasons.cantScan1: The passenger's phone is off or not working
reasons.cantScan2: No internet on the passenger's phone
reasons.cantScan3: The passenger was in a hurry

tripView.needsApproval: The passenger did not confirm the start, so the transport office will check this trip.
tripView.longTripReminder: This trip has been running for a long time. End it when you arrive.
tripView.arriveReminder: When you arrive, end the trip before the passenger leaves the car.
tripView.pendingApproval: The passenger could not confirm, so the transport office will approve this trip.
tripView.closedTitle: The transport office closed this trip
tripView.haveAGoodTrip: Have a good trip. Drive safely.

passenger.startTitle: Confirm you are in this car
passenger.startPhotoAlt: Dashboard photo at the start of the trip
passenger.driversPhone: This is the driver's own phone. The passenger has to scan the QR code with their own phone.
passenger.idHint: As on your ID card, for example EMP-1234.
passenger.triesLeft: {left, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}
passenger.phoneNeeded: Please type a valid phone number.
passenger.phoneHint: You will type the same number again at the end of the trip.
passenger.startDoneBody: Thank you, {name}. Your trip has started.
passenger.atTheEnd: When you arrive, the driver will show you another QR code. Scan it and type the same employee ID to confirm the end of the trip.
passenger.atTheEndVisitor: When you arrive, the driver will show you another QR code. Scan it and type the same phone number to confirm the end of the trip.
passenger.endTitle: Confirm the end of your trip
passenger.endPhotoAlt: Dashboard photo at the end of the trip
passenger.endIdHint: The same ID you typed at the start.
passenger.endPhoneHint: The same number you gave at the start.
passenger.endDoneBody: Thank you for confirming. Have a good day.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
errors.idNotFound: We could not find this employee ID. Check it and try again.
errors.idNotFoundLeft: We could not find this employee ID. {left, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
errors.mismatch: This ID does not match the passenger who started the trip.
errors.mismatchLeft: This ID does not match the passenger who started the trip. {left, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
errors.phoneMismatch: This number does not match the one given at the start.
errors.phoneMismatchLeft: This number does not match the one given at the start. {left, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
errors.DRIVER_CANNOT_CONFIRM: This is the driver's own phone. Please scan with your own phone.
errors.PASSENGER_IS_DRIVER: This is the driver's ID. Please type your own employee ID.
errors.VISITORS_NOT_ALLOWED: Visitors cannot be confirmed here. Please ask the transport office.
errors.WRONG_PASSENGER_TYPE: This trip was started by a different kind of passenger. Ask the driver to check.

QR_INVALID.title: This code is not valid
QR_INVALID.body: The link may be incomplete. Ask the driver to show the QR code again and scan it with your phone camera.

WRONG_QR.title: Wrong code for this step
WRONG_QR.body: This code is for a different step of the trip. Ask the driver for the right QR code.

QR_USED.title: This code has already been used
QR_USED.body: The trip was already confirmed with this code. Nothing more to do, you can close this page.

TRIP_CANCELLED.title: This trip was cancelled
TRIP_CANCELLED.body: The driver cancelled this trip, so there is nothing to confirm. You can close this page.

QR_BLOCKED.title: This code is locked
QR_BLOCKED.body: There were too many wrong tries. Ask the driver to contact the transport office.

QR_REPLACED.title: The driver made a new code
QR_REPLACED.body: This code was replaced by a newer one. Scan the new QR code on the driver's phone.

QR_EXPIRED.title: This code has expired
QR_EXPIRED.body: Codes only last a few minutes. Ask the driver to tap "New QR" and scan again.

TRIP_NOT_WAITING.title: This trip is not waiting for you
TRIP_NOT_WAITING.body: The trip has moved on (it may already be confirmed or closed). You can close this page.

TOO_MANY_LOOKUPS.title: Too many tries
TOO_MANY_LOOKUPS.body: Please wait a few minutes before trying again, or ask the driver to contact the transport office.

OFFLINE.title: Can't reach the server
OFFLINE.body: Check your internet connection and open the link again.

OTHER.title: Something went wrong
OTHER.body: Ask the driver to show the QR code again and scan it once more.

adminAuth.hero: Every company car, live, in one place.
adminAuth.point1: See which car is where and who is driving
adminAuth.point3: Reports for any day or month
adminAuth.title: Sign in
adminAuth.lead: Use the username and password the system admin gave you.
adminAuth.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to carry on where you were.
adminAuth.sessionNote: You stay signed in for 8 hours on this computer. Sign out when you leave a shared computer.
adminAuth.driverLink: Are you a driver? Driver sign in
adminAuth.errWrong: Username or password is not correct.
adminAuth.errLocked: Too many wrong tries. Wait 15 minutes, or ask another admin to check your account.
adminAuth.errNetwork: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
adminAuth.errServer: Something went wrong. Please try again.
adminAuth.offlineBody: The backend is not answering. Check that it is running, then reload this page.
adminAuth.roleAdminHint: Can change trips, cars, people and settings.
adminAuth.roleViewerHint: Can look at everything, but not change it.
